candidates.change_summary: Delete the assignment 'betLimit = amount;' so AdjustBetAmounts no longer changes betLimit.
Replace the assignment with 'betLimit = amount + 1;' so the stored betLimit differs from the requested amount.
Delete the require statement in the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can adjust betLimit via AdjustBetAmounts.
Assign amount minus one to difficulty instead of amount.
Add amount to difficulty instead of overwriting it.
Write amount into betLimit instead of difficulty, leaving difficulty unchanged.
Invert the ownership check so non-owners can adjust difficulty and owners cannot.
Set openToPublic to false instead of true so calling OpenToThePublic never opens the contract.
Remove the assignment so OpenToThePublic has no effect on openToPublic.
Invert the onlyOwner check so the owner cannot call OpenToThePublic while non-owners can.
Remove the require so anyone (not just the owner) can call OpenToThePublic and open the contract.
Replace assignment with an increment so betLimit accumulates instead of being set.
Delete the assignment so betLimit is never updated.
Insert a guard requiring a positive amount so calls with amount == 0 revert instead of setting betLimit to 0.
Invert the owner check so non-owners pass and the owner is blocked, changing who can update betLimit.
